propositions: Every new plan review must sign cryptographic pins for all direct children and normalized prerequisites, binding their canonical IDs, roles, and current material fingerprints.
Material drift in a pinned prerequisite or child invalidates the downstream attestation only when enforcement is enabled; disabled enforcement reports drift as advisory.
Execution-phase reviews apply a fixed 0.80 priority-floor threshold to blocking criteria while preserving advisory-only criteria and lower-priority findings.
The plan_review_phase projection (planning or execution) is maintained in compiled state across SNAPSHOT compaction and updated only by winning process_status events.
Close enforcement requires a current compatible plan review when both require_plan_review_for_close and enforce_plan_material_pins are enabled; code freshness alone does not invalidate the review.
Prerequisite consistency evaluation receives isolated prompt calls with each prerequisite's current material and returns one three-disposition coverage record per canonical prerequisite.
